subject: Demo recap + conversion play — POC outline and success gates for Greengrid Energy
messages:
From: Aditi Roy <aditi.roy@greengrid.energy>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@greengrid.energy>
Cc: procurement@greengrid.energy
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap & conversion play — Redwood POC ask

Ben — thanks for the walkthrough today. Sam and I regrouped and we’re aligned on running a short hands-on POC to validate two things: 1) accuracy of Redwood’s NER + entity-normalization on our meter/asset feed, and 2) latency/throughput characteristics with our ingestion pattern.

High-level success criteria (what our execs will sign off on):
- Entity extraction precision/recall >= 0.92 on our 10k sample (metric: token-level F1 for primary entity types).
- Normalization correctness >= 0.90 for mapping to our asset registry.
- 99th percentile end-to-end response latency < 350ms for streaming inference when batched to 16.
- Integration: automated export of results to our S3 bucket + sample dashboard update.

Preferred timing: a 4-week engagement starting the week of Sept 7 if we can lock scope this week. Procurement will want an estimated cost + minimal SOW to fast-track internal approvals. Attaching a small sample of the data we discussed (initial-data-sample.csv).

Questions for you: can Redwood provide a short mutual action plan (owners, week-by-week deliverables, acceptance gates) + a shortlist of model variants you propose for the POC (and whether quantized variants are available for cost testing)? Also need SOC2 in-scope evidence and an approximate committed capacity price for a 4-week reserved pilot.

Thanks — Aditi
Aditi Roy
Head of Data Products, Greengrid Energy
aditi.roy@greengrid.energy

---
Attachment: initial-data-sample.csv (CSV, 2.3 MB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditi Roy <aditi.roy@greengrid.energy>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@greengrid.energy>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, priyom.das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & conversion play — Redwood POC ask

Aditi — really appreciate the clear ask and the sample data. High level: we can run the 4-week POC with a focused scope that maps to your success criteria. Below is a proposed mutual action plan + owners. Please review and flag anything you want tweaked.

Proposed POC outline (4 weeks) — Redwood / Greengrid owners
Week 0 (prep, 2–3 days):
- Kickoff + account prep: access to sample S3 staging, dataset ingestion test (Ben, Greengrid: Aditi)
- Environment: provision private trial tenant in us-east-1, baseline network/connectivity check (Vivek)

Week 1 (model baseline & fast-fail):
- Run baseline runs with two model variants (opt-bert-large, opt-llama-13B-quant) on 10k sample; produce baseline metrics (Ben, Vivek)
- Small integration script to push result to staging S3 (Priyom)

Week 2 (tuning & integration):
- Iterate on prompt schema, normalization rules, and entity mapping heuristics (Ben, Greengrid data lead)
- Add automated exports and a sanity dashboard (Priyom)

Week 3 (stress & acceptance):
- Run end-to-end acceptance runs, measure latency at target batch sizes, generate final metrics and report (Ben, Vivek)
- Prepare acceptance artifact for Greengrid sign-off

Acceptance gates (what Greengrid signs off on):
- Metric thresholds: NER F1 >= 0.92 and normalization >= 0.90 on the evaluation sample; 99th% latency < 350ms at batch=16 OR documented tradeoff plan if latency > target
- Integration verified: automated exports to your S3 path + example dashboard update
- SOC2 evidence delivered to procurement for review (we can provide our attestations and an SOC2 summary report)

Attachments: I’ve attached a short POC outline and an SLA sketch for procurement review (redwood-poc-outline.xlsx, redwood-sla-draft.pdf). Also linking the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/GRG-29834.

Estimated engagement cost (rough order):
- Trial reserved capacity + infra + 3rd-party monitoring: est. $15k–$22k for the 4-week window depending on chosen model variant and burst needs. We can narrow to a fixed pilot quote once Greengrid confirms the desired variant and capacity commit.

Next steps / immediate asks:
1) Confirm you’re OK with the acceptance gates above or propose changes to the thresholds.
2) Confirm preferred kickoff week (you suggested week of Sept 7).
3) Procurement contact to start SOC2 + T&Cs review (CC’d procurement earlier).

If that all looks good I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff with your data team and loop in our solutions engineer for the integration plan.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

---
Attachments: redwood-poc-outline.xlsx (XLSX, 120 KB); redwood-sla-draft.pdf (PDF, 180 KB)
From: Aditi Roy <aditi.roy@greengrid.energy>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@greengrid.energy>, procurement@greengrid.energy
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & conversion play — Redwood POC ask

Thanks Ben — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick notes from our side:
- Success gates: fine with NER F1 >= 0.92, but can we relax normalization acceptance to 0.88 for the pilot and have a follow-on optimization target at >=0.90? Execs are comfortable with a two-step acceptance if we get clear improvement actions documented.
- Region: must be us-east-1 for data sovereignty reasons.
- SOC2: procurement needs a copy of your SOC2 Type II report or an authorized summary; also a short runbook on how audit logs are retained during the pilot.
- Procurement point: procurement@greengrid.energy will start an initial review next week; budget code is GG-2026-PILOT.

We’re broadly good to kick the week of Sept 7. Please go ahead and schedule the kickoff 30-min meeting with Vivek and our data engineer (I’ll share a calendar invite once you propose times).

Appreciate the estimated cost — procurement will want a line-item quote but $15k–22k range is in the ballpark.

Best — Aditi

---

Subject: Fwd: Demo recap & conversion play — Redwood POC ask

Marissa / Priyom / Vivek — forwarding the thread from Greengrid. They accepted the high-level plan but asked two changes: (1) normalization acceptance for pilot = 0.88 (final target 0.90+), (2) region must be us-east-1. Procurement will kick off next week (budget code GG-2026-PILOT).

Action items for our side:
- Vivek: standby to provision a private trial tenant in us-east-1 and confirm networking requirements (VPC peering / S3 access patterns).
- Priyom: please prepare the integration script template and a short demo notebook to show automated S3 export + dashboard refresh.
- Marissa: can you approve mobilizing a small trial quote (range $15k–22k) so I can send procurement a line-item? If yes I’ll convert the estimate into a pilot SOW and attach to HubSpot deal GRG-29834.

I’ve included the full quoted thread below for context. Will wait for your OK and then propose 3 kickoff slots for the week of Sept 7.

— Ben
